item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 26/Nov/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the persistent influence of the northeast monsoon and its replenishment, the weather will be generally fine and dry over the coast of Guangdong in the next few days. It will be cool in the morning and at night. The temperature difference between day and night will be rather large. With the monsoon moderating gradually early next week, temperatures over Guangdong will rise slightly. A dry easterly airstream is expected to affect the coast of southern China early to midweek next week.
